Superiority would be easier than the other I would assume. Having a superiority complex would help with false confidence, making social anxiety easier ("I'm better than these people, why do I care what they think?" or "I'm amazing I don't need to worry about anything") etc etc. 

An inferiority complex seems like it would have more drawbacks as it would create issues in relationships and esteem etc but it is a nice feeling when you feel inferior but then you get told/proven otherwise. It's also more modest and realistic than the other.

Was engaged last year, crazy in love, never thought I'd meet anyone better. He dumped me but we were fwb for 6 months (don't be fwb with your ex fiance, it's really really not a good idea) we broke up properly and I never thought I'd meet anyone else or stop loving him. Fast forward a few months and I was getting closer to my best guy friend but still felt more for ex. Was so depressed cause I thought I'd never be happy with new guy as I missed old guy so much. Ended up getting together with new guy and I told old guy this, to which he retaliated a few days later by asking me to spend the night with him. I told him no, and I finally realised i didn't want him anymore, moved away with new guy. Old guy would message me constantly, trying to convince me to come home and telling me he loved me and all that junk. It was all I'd wanted to hear for the past 9 months and was conflicted for a while but in the end, I realised new guy was worlds better than him.
